rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: PyDESeq2 Wald test on the unpaired 6 vs 6 single-batch design, ~condition with control as explicit reference and a named contrast, median-of-ratios inside the model, a minimal 10-in-6 prefilter, BH at 0.05 with shrunken LFC reported beside the unshrunken estimate and no post hoc fold-change cut. QC is complete and specific (library sizes, detected genes, blind VST PCA on 500 genes, distance heatmap, sample_01 kept with a stated keep/drop policy and a leave-one-out sensitivity fit). Enrichment uses gseapy prerank on the full Wald-ranked list against MSigDB Hallmark 2026.1 with the 15-500 window, tested-gene universe and a fixed seed, and the report section names every required element. Minor deductions: the plan asserts 'apeglm' shrinkage although PyDESeq2 provides only an apeglm-like normal-prior shrinkage, and the extra voom-style hand-rolled comparator adds complexity without being required by the design.
